availability_verbatim: Select areas in NM, but can join with a $10 donation

requirements.verbatim: Any checking account with direct deposit (no minimum mentioned) qualifies referred party for bonus
Alternative qualifier: a share certificate ($1,000 minimum)
Alternative qualifier: a loan or credit card

fee_waiver: Life essentials checking $5 monthly fee waived with e-statements, or if primary account holder is under 18 or over 65

churn.limit_language_verbatim: Limited to 5 referrals ($450 total) per person, though each shareable link may be used for up to 25 simultaneous referrals; each new member may only be referred once

superseded_values.stale_value: 2026-06-30 (per Offer at a glance box and referral links)

notes: This is a $90 REFERRAL bonus paid to both the referrer and the new member (bonus_total modeled as the per-person amount, i.e. what one person can earn from one successful referral).
